verdict.rationale: Fastmail's own Filters & Rules feature, plus a community report of a saved filter view of mail matching criteria, suggests users can manually route mail into separate folders or views. However, the evidence is only page titles, with no description of automatic categorization into priority streams such as important, team, newsletters or calendar invites. missing for 10: documented split-inbox or auto-categorized streams, priority-ordered triage views, automatic newsletter and calendar-invite separation, detailed first-party docs beyond page titles, hands-on corroboration.
